name: Waifu Slut School
source:
After getting into Hell, a sexy deviless, instead of taking your soul, offers you to work for her, seducing girls to take them to her. She will send you to a strange city where girls arrive unwillingly, desperately looking for a way out. Will you follow the devil's lead or help the famous girls in trouble? In any case, you must become the principal of the “Waifu Slut School” and making your own choices, decide your fate and the fate of your waifu.

[From itch.io]
translation:
进入地狱后，一个性感的女恶魔并没有夺走你的灵魂，而是邀请你为她工作，引诱女孩们把她们带到她身边。她会把你送到一个陌生的城市，女孩们不情愿地来到这里，拼命寻找出路。你会跟随魔鬼的脚步还是帮助陷入困境的著名女孩？无论如何，你必须成为“外婆荡妇学校”的校长，做出自己的选择，决定你和你外婆的命运。

[来自itch.io]
